commands.chx.timer: [HX] Please execute '/chx timer help' for more information.
commands.chx.timer_help_introduction: Timer is a necessary system allowed to act behavior after a time.
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext1: /chx timer template create: Create a new template timer (Apply to instance for use).
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext2: /chx timer template create_range: Create a new template timer by randomly selected time (Same apply method).
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext3: /chx timer template list: List out all timers.
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext4: /chx timer template delete ![timer_id]: Delete template timer.
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext5: /chx timer instance create: Create a new instance timer (For immediately use).
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext6: /chx timer instance create_range: Create a new instance timer by randomly selected time.
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext7: /chx timer instance list ![master_id]: List out all timers from registered id.
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext12: /chx timer instance apply ![timer_id] ![target_id]: Apply template timer to instance for use.
commands.chx.timer_help_innertext14: /chx timer instance modify: Modify time data.
commands.chx.scene: [HX] Please execute '/chx scene help' for more information.

commands.chx.scene_help_innertext3: /chx scene list: List out all available scene documents.
commands.chx.scene_help_innertext4: /chx scene play ![scene_id]: Play the specific scene.
commands.chx.scene_help_innertext5: /chx scene create ![to_path]: Submit book and analysis as YAML document.
commands.chx.scene_help_innertext7: /chx scene template: Receive a book contains YAML scene template.

commands.chx.attribute_help_innertext4: /chx attribute list api: List out all registered attributes (Required admin).
commands.chx.attribute_help_innertext9: /chx attribute read ![attribute_id] !{zero/recovery/maximum/recovery_interval/group}: Read general attribute data.
commands.chx.attribute_help_innertext10: /chx attribute read ![attribute_id] !{value} #[player_id]: Read self's/specific player's attribute value.
commands.chx.attribute_help_modify_argum: --> Argument: ... modify !{set/add/reduce} ![value] #[direction(Define behavior when pass through exact threshold)]
commands.chx.attribute_help_innertext12: /chx attribute recovery: Define threshold's dynamic recovery behavior.
commands.chx.attribute_help_recovery_arg: --> Argument: ... recovery !{simple} ![attribute_id] ![interval] ![interval_unit] #[direction(Define behavior when pass through exact threshold)]
commands.chx.attribute_help_innertext13: /chx attribute display ![attribute_id] #{true/false}: Display to F4 page.
